target.statement: VDTR achieves 33.13 dB PSNR on the DVD dataset (best among compared methods)

compute.basis: Training VDTR requires 8 V100 GPUs for days; even inference on the full DVD test set (1000 frames) with a 23.2M-param transformer at 720p is slow on CPU, and reproducing the number requires training the model.

blockers: Training requires 8 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs (32GB each)
No pretrained model weights provided in the repo
Full training takes days on multi-GPU hardware
title: VDTR: Video Deblurring with Transformer
